space_blender: Positions and directions are in metres relative to the root, in the rig's axes: -Y is the way the character faces, +X its left, +Z up. `direction` is the way the root travels at `speed`. `ball_frames` are the first and last frame the ball rides in the socket named by `ball`.
space_gltf: Positions in the original notes are Blender rig axes: -Y forward, +X the athlete's left, +Z up. In glTF/three.js that is +Z forward, +X the athlete's left, +Y up: (x, y, z)_gltf = (x, z, -y)_blender. A `direction` [dx, dy] becomes (dx, 0, -dy) in the athlete's local glTF frame.
timing: Every clip has frames+1 keys (0..frames) at 30 fps; duration = frames/30 s. For loops the last key equals the first, so LoopRepeat over the full duration is seamless (the game wraps at frames/30).

clips.name: Idle
clips.notes: Relaxed athletic stand; breathing and a slow weight shift. Frame 0 is the anchor pose.

clips.name: Run
clips.notes: Full sprint. Frame 0 = left foot contact, frame 8 = right foot contact.

clips.name: Jog
clips.notes: Easy run. Frame 0 = left foot contact, frame 10 = right foot contact.

clips.name: RunBall
clips.notes: Sprint with the ball tucked in the right arm; same phase and length as Run.

clips.name: JogBall
clips.notes: Gather at half speed, carry tight, free hand ready to fend. Left cleat strikes on frame zero.

clips.name: Backpedal
clips.notes: Defensive backpedal, hips low. Moves BACKWARD (+Y) at `speed` while facing -Y. Frame 0 = left foot contact (reaching back), frame 10 = right foot contact.

clips.name: ShuffleL
clips.notes: Lateral shuffle toward the character's LEFT (+X) at `speed`, facing -Y, feet never cross. Frame 0 = left (lead) foot contact, frame 8 = right foot contact.

clips.name: ShuffleR
clips.notes: Mirror of ShuffleL: moves toward the character's RIGHT (-X). Frame 0 = left (trailing) foot contact, frame 8 = right (lead) foot contact.

clips.name: Ready
clips.notes: Two-point stance for receivers and defenders before the snap; light bounce on the balls of the feet.

clips.name: Stance3
clips.notes: Three-point lineman stance, right hand on the ground; nearly still.

clips.name: StanceCenter
clips.notes: Centre crouched over the ball: right hand on a ball lying on the ground 0.45 m in front of the root (ball centre (0, -0.45, 0.085), long axis along Y). The ball is not socketed.

clips.name: StanceQB
clips.notes: Quarterback in the shotgun: slight crouch, open hands in front of the chest.

clips.name: QBSet
clips.notes: In the pocket, half turned to the right, ball at the chest in both hands, bouncing on the toes, head scanning. Frame 0 is the pose CatchSnap ends in and Throw / Handoff start from.

clips.name: QBDrop
clips.notes: Drop-back: moves BACKWARD (+Y) at `speed`, body turned to the right, ball high in both hands, eyes downfield. Frame 0 = left foot contact, frame 10 = right foot contact.

clips.name: BlockLoop
clips.notes: Engaged blocker: low base, feet chopping (3 steps per foot), alternating hand strikes and a braced recovery.

clips.name: DownBack
clips.notes: Flat on the back, head toward +Y, pelvis 0.25 m behind the root. Anchor pose for HitBack / HitFlip / GetUpBack.

clips.name: DownFront
clips.notes: Face down, head toward -Y, pelvis 0.25 m in front of the root. Anchor pose for dives, HitFront / HitSpin and GetUpFront.

clips.name: Snap
clips.notes: Centre fires a shotgun snap back between the legs, then comes up into the BlockLoop pose. Starts from StanceCenter. The ball is not socketed: at `release` the right hand is at about (0.0, 0.07, 0.27), under the hips, moving back at ~7 m/s.

clips.name: CatchSnap
clips.notes: QB takes the shotgun snap at chest height and settles into QBSet frame 0. Starts from StanceQB. Attach the ball to ball_hand_r at `catch`.

clips.name: Throw
clips.notes: Overhand pass with the right arm: wind up, step with the left foot, whip, follow through. Starts from QBSet frame 0; ends in a staggered athletic stand (left foot 0.4 m forward). Detach the ball at `release`: ball_hand_r is then at (-0.03, -0.69, 1.84) and its Y axis points downfield, slightly up.

clips.name: Handoff
clips.notes: QB turns to his right and extends the ball at belly height. Starts from QBSet frame 0. At `give` the ball (ball_hand_r) is about 0.5 m to the right of the root, 1.05 m up, long axis along Y; detach it there.

clips.name: CatchChest
clips.notes: Catch at chest height: arms snap up, hands meet the ball, ball secured into the right-arm tuck. Works standing or as an upper-body layer over a run (the legs only give a little). Attach the ball to ball_hand_r at `catch`; by the last frame ball_hand_r has slid onto ball_tuck_r, so switching to a tuck clip does not pop.

clips.name: CatchHigh
clips.notes: Leaping overhead catch: gather, jump (the pelvis rises 0.5 m), full extension at the apex, land, tuck. Attach the ball to ball_hand_r at `catch`, when it is at (-0.02, -0.14, 2.57); it ends on the ball_tuck_r transform, so switching to a tuck clip does not pop.

clips.name: Swat
clips.notes: Defender leaps and swats with the right arm at full stretch: the fingertips reach (0.01, -0.09, 2.76) at `apex`, then slap forward and down through frames 9-12.

clips.name: DiveTackle
clips.notes: Launch flat and horizontal with the arms reaching, clamp at `hit`, land and slide prone into the DownFront pose. Airborne frames 4-12. The pelvis ends 0.25 m in front of the root.

clips.name: TackleWrap
clips.notes: Lunge, wrap both arms at waist height (`hit`), drive the runner down; ends prone with the arms still wrapped in front (DownFront with the arms forward). The pelvis ends 0.25 m ahead of the root.

clips.name: BigHit
clips.notes: Lower the right shoulder, explode up and through the target at `hit`, stay on the feet. The body drives about 0.3 m forward of the root and ends in an athletic stance 0.2 m ahead of it.

clips.name: Shove
clips.notes: Violent two-hand shove at chest height: hands load at the chest, arms lock out at `hit` with a step of the left foot.

clips.name: HitBack
clips.notes: Blasted from the front: chest caves, lifted off the feet, lands flat on the back and bounces into the DownBack pose (pelvis 0.25 m behind the root). Airborne frames 3-11.

clips.name: HitFront
clips.notes: Hit from behind: back arches, thrown forward off the feet, face-plants with the legs kicking up, settles into the DownFront pose (pelvis 0.25 m in front of the root). Airborne frames 3-9.

clips.name: HitFlip
clips.notes: The signature huge hit: legs cut out from under him, the body turns a forward flip in the air (pitch runs from 0 through upside-down to 270 deg, pelvis peaks 1.5 m up at frame 11) and crashes onto the back, bouncing into the DownBack pose. Airborne frames 3-19.

clips.name: GetUpBack
clips.notes: From DownBack to Idle: knees tuck and the body rocks back, rocks forward onto the heels with a push of both hands, rises out of a deep squat. The feet plant where Idle has them (frame 10) and stay there; the pelvis travels from 0.25 m behind the root to over it.

clips.name: GetUpFront
clips.notes: From DownFront to Idle: hands plant, push-up, the right foot steps under the body, then the left, and he stands. Both feet finish where Idle has them; the pelvis travels from 0.25 m in front of the root to over it.

clips.name: Stumble
clips.notes: Staggered by a hit but stays up: pitches forward and drops, the free arm flails for the ground, then he recovers. Built on one RunBall cycle, so it starts and ends on RunBall frame 0 (left foot contact) and keeps its foot timing (authored for 8 m/s). Reads fine without a ball too.

clips.name: StiffArm
clips.notes: Runner drives the LEFT arm out straight into a tackler; the ball stays tucked right. Built on one RunBall cycle (16 frames instead of 14, so the legs are exactly RunBall's and the clip starts and ends on RunBall frame 0): use it whole or as an upper-body layer over RunBall.

clips.name: Spin
clips.notes: Full 360 deg spin to the left (counter-clockwise seen from above) done through the pelvis; the root does not turn. Pivots on the left foot (frames 0-5) then the right (6-12). Starts and ends on RunBall frame 0. Planted feet drift back at roughly 3 m/s.

clips.name: JukeL
clips.notes: Hard plant on the right foot (frames 4-8, 0.36 m out to the right) and cut to the LEFT. Starts and ends on RunBall frame 0 (left foot contact).

clips.name: JukeR
clips.notes: Mirror of JukeL: hard plant on the left foot and cut to the RIGHT; the ball stays in the right arm. Starts and ends on RunBall frame 8 (right foot contact).

clips.name: Hurdle
clips.notes: Leap over a low tackler with both knees tucked: takes off from the left foot at frame 3, the pelvis peaks 0.7 m up at frame 9, lands on the right foot at frame 15 and runs out. Starts and ends on RunBall frame 0.

clips.name: DiveBall
clips.notes: Ball carrier dives headfirst with the ball stretched out in front in both hands, lands and ends prone holding it out (DownFront with the arms forward; the ball lies about 1.35 m in front of the root). Starts on RunBall frame 0 with ball_hand_r sitting on ball_tuck_r, so coming from a tuck clip does not pop. Airborne frames 4-12.

clips.name: Kick
clips.notes: Placekick / kickoff with the right foot: two approach steps (right, then the left plant at frame 13), swing through, follow through with a hop. The root stays still: the steps are real (the pelvis travels from 0.30 m behind the root to 0.32 m ahead of it and stays there). Put the ball at (-0.18, -0.79, 0.11) (tee height); the instep reaches it at `contact`.

clips.name: Punt
clips.notes: Punt with the right leg: two steps while the ball is held out in both hands, the right hand lets it go at `drop` (ball_hand_r at (-0.10, -0.61, 1.10)), the instep meets it at `contact` around (-0.12, -1.12, 0.58), big follow-through with a hop. The root stays still: the steps are real and small (the pelvis travels from 0.18 m behind the root to 0.28 m ahead of it and stays there).

clips.name: PickUp
clips.notes: Scoop a loose ball off the ground on the move with the right hand: dip over a long right step, grab at about (-0.24, -0.44, 0.09) from the root, come up tucking it. Attach the ball to ball_hand_r at `grab`; it ends on the ball_tuck_r transform. Starts on Run frame 0 and ends on RunBall frame 0; planted feet drift back at about 5 m/s.

clips.name: CelebSpike
clips.notes: Spike and flex: the ball goes up overhead in the right hand and is slammed into the turf at `spike` (it leaves ball_hand_r at (0.06, -0.85, 0.82), going straight down), then a hop, a stomping low flex with two pulses, and back to the Idle stand. Starts with ball_hand_r sitting on ball_tuck_r, so it follows a tuck clip without a pop.

clips.name: CelebDance
clips.notes: Looping end-zone dance: hips swing side to side with a step-touch (20-frame period) with alternating cross-body punches, knees bouncing and the head bobbing on every beat.

clips.name: CelebFlex
clips.notes: Gather low, then explode into a double-biceps flex with the chest out and the head thrown back, roaring at the sky; two pumps (frames 20 and 29), then back to an idle stand.

clips.name: Dejected
clips.notes: Head down, hands on hips, weight on one leg; a long sigh and a slow shake of the head.

clips.name: Signal1st
clips.notes: First-down signal: the right arm winds up by the ear and chops forward to point downfield with a step of the left foot (`point`), a second small chop, then back to an idle stand.

clips.name: HitSpin
clips.notes: Hit from the left side: knocked flat and face down in the air, the body helicopters a full turn about the vertical (yaw 0 to 360 over frames 2-17) with arms and legs flung wide, belly flops and settles into the DownFront pose. Airborne frames 3-16.

clips.name: ElbowDrop
clips.notes: A cartoonishly late hit: wind up over a player lying in front, jump, lay out sideways and drop the right elbow at `hit` -- the point of the elbow comes down at (0.17, -1.13, 0.30), about chest height of someone lying on the ground there -- land on the right hip propped on that elbow, then roll off onto the front (ends in the DownFront pose). Airborne frames 8-15.

clips.name: GroundHitBack
clips.notes: Recoil from a late elbow, then settle back onto the turf.

clips.name: GroundHitFront
clips.notes: Recoil from a late elbow, then settle back onto the turf.
